searchDocs.title: ObserveSpectrum​
searchDocs.content: </> AudioSpectrumAnalyzer:ObserveSpectrum() → ( Types.Signal, () → () ) Observes the spectrum data of the audio. This returns a signal that fires every frame with the current spectrum data. The second return value is a function that can be called to stop observing the spectrum data.

searchDocs.title: GetPeak​
searchDocs.content: </> AudioSpectrumAnalyzer:GetPeak() → () Returns the current peak level of the audio. This is a number between 0 and 1 representing the peak level of the audio.
